On the identity of the a., see A. K. Warder, Ind. Bud. p. 388, fn. 2. For contents of Chinese transl. by Kumārajīva (402-05 A. D.), see J.. 219 (1931) App. p. 155.
See also Aṣṭasāhasrikāprajñāpāramitā, Intro. p. xv. of Bud. Skt. Texts 4, Mithila Inst. of PG. Studies, Darbhanga, 1960.
